'''Sunyshore Tower''' (Japanese: '''ナギサタワー''' ''{{tt|Nagisa|Sunyshore}} Tower'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive building located in [[Sunyshore City]]. The Tower provides the required energy for the various technological machines in Sunyshore City.

In ''[[DP165|Flint Sparks the Fire!]]'', {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, along with [[Flint]], found [[Volkner]] inside the tower. Ash asked Volkner for a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} but was refused. 

In ''[[DP166|The Fleeing Tower of Sunyshore!]]'', {{TRT}} stole the tower and turned it into a rocket ship in order to take it to Team Rocket Headquarters. However, they were defeated by Ash and his newly evolved {{AP|Torterra}}. Volkner returned the tower to its original place, but since it was heavily damaged, he put off the Gym battle with Ash so he could repair it.

Team Rocket once again tried to infiltrate the Tower in ''[[DP179|The Eighth Wonder of the Sinnoh World!]]'', but Volkner had improved the security in the Tower, which made it impossible to take control like they did before. However, they managed to short-circuit the power supply to the [[Sunyshore Gym]], shutting out the power while {{Ash}} and Volkner had their Gym battle.

==Trivia==
* The Sunyshore Tower is similar to the [[Vista Lighthouse]]. Volkner can be found in the Vista Lighthouse in the games, refusing to accept Gym opponents, as he does in this episode of the animated series.
* The Sunyshore Tower resembles the {{wp|Tower of the Sun}}, the symbol of {{wp|Expo '70}} held in {{wp|Osaka, Japan}}.
